steps.title: Maintain and Passage PSCs
steps.instruction: Maintain engineered PSCs in a 37°C, 5% CO₂ incubator, keeping confluency between 30–80%.

substeps.instruction: Coat 6-well plates with Vitronectin (1:100 dilution in DPBS no Ca²⁺/Mg²⁺), adding 1 mL per well; incubate ≥1 hour at RT or overnight at 4°C.
Warm Essential 8 (E8) medium to RT or 37°C.
Seed thawed PSCs onto coated plates in E8 medium and change medium daily.
Passage cells twice weekly (every 3–4 days): aspirate medium, rinse with DPBS, add 1 mL of 0.5 mM EDTA per well, and incubate at RT for 4–5 minutes.
Gently tap the plate or use a pipette to dislodge colonies without breaking them into single cells.
Reseed cell clumps onto new Vitronectin-coated plates with fresh E8 medium at a 1:6 to 1:10 split ratio.
Replace medium the next day and daily thereafter.

steps.title: Generate iCas9 WA09 hESC Line
steps.instruction: Sequentially engineer WA09 human embryonic stem cells to introduce the APP^swe/swe mutation using an inducible Cas9 system.

substeps.instruction: Transfect WA09 hESCs with AAVS1-targeting sgRNA and hygro-resistant iCas9 donor plasmid.
Select for stable integration using hygromycin B (50–100 µg/mL) for 7–10 days, then expand surviving colonies.
Confirm targeted insertion at AAVS1 locus via PCR and/or sequencing.
Induce Cas9 expression with 1–2 µg/mL doxycycline for 24–48 hours and confirm via western blot or RT-qPCR (optional).
Perform karyotyping to verify genomic integrity.

steps.title: Insert APP^swe/swe Mutation
steps.instruction: Introduce the APP^swe/swe mutation into the verified iCas9 line.

substeps.instruction: Transfect or electroporate the iCas9 line with APP-targeting sgRNA and either an ssODN or plasmid donor carrying the APP^swe/swe mutation.
Induce Cas9 with doxycycline for 24–48 hours post-transfection.
Allow recovery and expand clones for screening.
Perform final karyotyping on validated APP^swe/swe clones and freeze validated clones.

steps.title: Generate LRRK2 G2019S Mutation
steps.instruction: Edit Nurr1-GFP ESCs to introduce the LRRK2 G2019S mutation.

substeps.instruction: Dissociate Nurr1-GFP ESCs using Accutase (5–10 min at 37°C) and seed onto Matrigel-coated dishes (1:50) at 25,000 cells/cm² in E8 medium + 10 µM Y-27632.
Replace medium with mTeSR1 (without Y-27632) the following day.
Perform initial transfection: mix pX458 LRRK2 gRNA vector and ssODN donor at 5:1 ratio (250 ng total DNA per 25k cells) using Lipofectamine™ Stem; incubate in mTeSR1 at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Repeat transfection on Day 2 and Day 3 using 250 ng ssODN only (no plasmid) per 25k cells via Lipofectamine™ Stem.
Sort GFP-positive cells via FACS 24 hours after the final transfection and seed as single cells into Matrigel-coated 96-well plates in mTeSR1 + 10 µM Y-27632.
Expand clones for 6 days in mTeSR1, then switch to E8 medium for further expansion into 48-well and 6-well plates.
Genotype clones by extracting gDNA, PCR-amplifying the LRRK2 target region, and performing BceAI digestion (loss of site confirms mutation).
Confirm biallelic or monoallelic editing via Sanger sequencing.
Perform metaphase spread karyotyping and proceed only with normal clones.

steps.title: Differentiate hESCs into Cortical Neurons
steps.instruction: Differentiate H9 cells into cortical neurons over a 30+ day period.

substeps.instruction: Day -1: Dissociate H9 cells with Accutase and plate at 300,000 cells/cm² onto Matrigel-coated plates (1:30 in DMEM/F12) in E8 + 10 µM Y-27632 overnight. (Matrigel coating: thaw on ice, dilute 1:30 in cold DMEM/F12, 1 mL/well, incubate 4°C up to 1 week or 37°C for 2h).
Day 0–3: Feed daily with XLSB in E6 containing SB431542 (10 µM), LDN193189 (100 nM), and XAV939 (2 µM) once 100% confluency is reached.
Day 4–10: Feed daily with LSB in E6 containing SB431542 (10 µM) and LDN193189 (100 nM) (remove XAV).
Day 10–20: Feed daily with fresh N2/B27 medium (no vitamin A).

Day 20: Lift cells with Accutase (30 min at 37°C) and plate at 100,000–150,000 cells/cm² on PO/Laminin/Fibronectin-coated plates in NB/B27 + L-glutamine + Pen/Strep + 10 µM Y-27632 + DAPT (10 µM). (Coating: Poly-L-ornithine 15 µg/mL in DPBS overnight at 37°C, wash 2-3x, add Laminin I + Fibronectin 2 µg/mL each in DPBS overnight at 37°C).
Day 20–30: Maintain in NB/B27 + DAPT (no Y-27632), changing half the medium every 5 days.
Day 30+: Culture in NB/B27 + L-glutamine + BAGC cocktail (BDNF, GDNF, cAMP, Ascorbic Acid at 1:500 each), changing ~½ medium twice per week.

steps.title: Perform Genome-wide CRISPR Screen
steps.instruction: Conduct a CRISPR screen using the Brunello gRNA library in PSCs and differentiated neurons.

substeps.instruction: Dissociate PSCs with Accutase and plate 250 million cells per line at 150,000 cells/cm² in E8 + 10 µM Y-27632 on Matrigel-coated plates.
Transduce with Brunello lentiviral gRNA library at MOI 0.3–0.5 during replating; incubate 16–18 hours.
Replace media with fresh E8; after ~24 hours, add 0.4 µg/mL puromycin for 48–72 hours.
Dissociate selected PSCs with Accutase, pool, and plate 116 million cells for differentiation following the cortical differentiation protocol.
Day 20 (T=0): Dissociate cultures with Accutase into single-cell suspensions. Split into triplicates (90 million cells/replicate). Harvest T=0 controls (no doxycycline).
Plate remaining cells at 200,000 cells/cm² in Neurobasal + N2 + B27 + 10 µM Y-27632. Add 2 µg/mL doxycycline to half (+DOX) and leave half untreated (-DOX).
Maintain +DOX samples for 48 hours, then replace medium with neural maintenance medium + DAPT (1 µM).
Maintain cells until DIV 30 (half media change every 2–3 days), then continue to DIV 65 with BAGC or neurotrophic factors.
DIV 65: Wash monolayers 2x with PBS, incubate in 0.5 mM EDTA for 5 min at RT, scrape cells, pellet (300 x g, 5 min), snap freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at -80°C.
Extract gDNA, quantify with Qubit, amplify gRNA sequences with Illumina-compatible primers, verify with Agilent Bioanalyzer, and sequence using Illumina HiSeq 2500.

steps.title: Analyze CRISPR Screen Data
steps.instruction: Process sequencing data using the MAGECK-MLE pipeline.

substeps.instruction: Align FASTQ reads to the Brunello sgRNA reference library and generate a raw count matrix.
Normalize the matrix using non-targeting control sgRNAs.
Run MAGeCK-MLE analysis for WT and APP^swe/swe genotypes using DIV20 (T=0) or DIV65 -DOX samples as controls to obtain Beta scores, P-values, and FDR.
Identify viability genes (Beta < 0, FDR < 0.3, P < 0.05 in both genotypes) and candidate age regulators (viability criteria met only in APP^swe/swe).

steps.title: Perform Immunocytochemistry and Imaging
steps.instruction: Quantify aging and viability markers in neurons using high-content imaging.

substeps.instruction: Plate cortical neurons in 96-well plates and culture until the desired time point.
Fix neurons: remove medium, wash once with PBS, fix in 4% paraformaldehyde for 10 min, and wash 3x with PBS (Volume per well: 50 μl).
Stain for markers (e.g., DAPI, mitochondrial content, oxidative stress) as previously described.
Acquire fluorescent images using Operetta microscope (at least 9 fields per well) with consistent laser power, gain, and exposure.
Analyze images with Harmony software: segment cells and identify live cells using minimum nuclear size and maximum DAPI intensity cutoffs.
Normalize fluorescence intensity to DMSO control (value = 1) and perform statistical testing (one-sample t-test or unpaired two-tailed t-test).

steps.title: Measure Aβ Secretion
steps.instruction: Quantify Aβ peptides in conditioned medium using MSD V-PLEX assay.

substeps.instruction: Collect conditioned medium 48 hours after media change/treatment; centrifuge at 500 x g for 5 min at 4°C and store supernatant at -80°C.
Perform MSD V-PLEX Aβ Peptide Panel 1 assay using 25 µL of medium per well, including standard curve and blanks.
Read plate via MSD instrument to determine Aβ38, Aβ40, and Aβ42 concentrations; calculate Total Aβ as the sum of the three.
Normalize Total Aβ to total protein content: lyse matched neurons with RIPA buffer + protease inhibitors, quantify protein via Precision Red assay, and divide Total Aβ by mean protein content.
Equilibrate Proteasome-Glo™ Cell-Based Buffer and lyophilized Luciferin Detection Reagent to RT.
Reconstitute Luciferin Detection Reagent with 10 mL of buffer.
Thaw and vortex Suc-LLVY-Glo™ substrate; prepare Proteasome-Glo™ Reagent by adding 50 µL of substrate to one bottle of reconstituted luciferin reagent.

steps.title: Overexpress UBA3 and NAE1
steps.instruction: Overexpress UBA3 or NAE1 using lentiviral vectors.

substeps.instruction: Clone Human UBA3 (HG16320-G) and NAE1 (HG14282-G) ORFs into pLV-EF1a-IRES-Puro vector (Addgene: 85132) via PCR-based cloning.
Harvest virus particles after 48h and concentrate using Amicon Ultra-15 Centrifugal Filter Unit (100kDa).
Add concentrated virus (UBA3, NAE1, or control) to neurons at 1:500 dilution at DIV 20.
Add 1 µg/mL puromycin on DIV 22 for 4 days to select for transduced neurons.

steps.title: Conduct Aβ42 Neurotoxicity Assay
steps.instruction: Evaluate neuronal viability under Aβ42 stress and chemical/genetic perturbations.

substeps.instruction: Apply treatments starting at specified DIV: For loss-of-function, add 5 μM Aβ42 or vehicle (DMSO+PBS) between DIV35-DIV45. For chemical neddylation manipulation, add 1μM MLN4924 or 1μM CSN5i3 concurrently with 5 μM Aβ42/vehicle starting DIV30. For long-term inhibition, add 1μM MLN4924 starting DIV30 and 5 μM Aβ42/vehicle for the last 7 days. For UBA3/NAE1 overexpression, add 5 μM Aβ42/vehicle on DIV30.
For the 7-day Aβ42 assay, include one full media change during treatment.

Assess viability using PrestoBlue: dilute PrestoBlue 1:10 in neural maintenance media (0.9 mL PrestoBlue to 8.1 mL media), aspirate culture media, add 85 μL per well, include ≥3 blank wells, incubate at 37°C for 2 hours, and measure absorbance (570nm and 600nm).

Alternatively, assess viability using CCK8: add 100 µL CCK8 solution to every 1 mL of neural maintenance media, aspirate culture media, add 110 μL per well, include ≥3 blank wells, incubate at 37°C for 2 hours, and measure absorbance (450nm).
Normalize absorbance to mean of no-doxycycline or DMSO control wells.

steps.title: Analyze Senescence and Protein Expression
steps.instruction: Perform flow cytometry and western blotting to analyze aging hallmarks.

substeps.instruction: Stain single cell suspensions with Zombie UV Fixable Viability Kit (1:2500 in PBS) for 15 min at RT, then fix in 4% PFA for 10 min at 4°C.
Stain with CellEvent Senescence Green (1:250 in assay buffer) for 2 hours at 37°C.

For intracellular probes: permeabilize in 0.5% Triton-X for 10 min (4°C), block in 5% BSA for 10 min, then stain with H3k9me3-PE antibody (1:200) and Proteostat (1:2500) in 5% BSA/PBS for 30 min at 4°C.
Wash 2x in FACS buffer and analyze on Cytek Aurora FlowCytometer.
Harvest protein: wash with ice-cold PBS, scrape cells into ice-cold PBS, centrifuge (600 x g, 5 min, 4°C), remove supernatant, and snap-freeze pellet.

Perform Western Blotting: load samples onto NuPAGE Novex 4-12% Bis Tris gels, transfer to PVDF (20% methanol buffer), block in 5% milk or BSA (for phospho-Tau), incubate with primary antibodies overnight at 4°C on a shaker, and visualize with BioRad ChemiDoc XRS+.

For Sarkosyl Fractionation: add sarkosyl to 1% final concentration, incubate at RT for 30 min, ultracentrifuge (150,000g, 30 min), decant soluble fraction, resuspend pellet in Laemmli buffer + reducing agent, boil at 95°C for 5 min, and blot using Reversible Protein Stain Kit for normalization.

steps.title: Validate sgRNA Viability
steps.instruction: Test specific sgRNAs for viability in WT and APP^swe/swe neurons.

substeps.instruction: Differentiate hESCs into cortical neurons and plate dissociated DIV20 cells into 96-well plates at 150,000 cells/cm² (3 technical replicates per condition).
Apply unconcentrated lentivirus at 1:30 dilution on DIV20 and DIV21. Add 2 µg/mL doxycycline to relevant wells simultaneously.
On DIV22, remove virus and doxycycline and add 1 µg/mL puromycin for 48 hours.
Maintain neurons until DIV60 and perform PrestoBlue Viability Assay.

description: Notes Protocol for fractionation of cell lysates from stem cell derived neurons was adapted from Manos et al. 77 Notes Avoid enzymatic dissociation to preserve colony morphology. Routinely test for mycoplasma contamination. Maintain consistent passage number for reproducibility. Step 4: Clone Screening and Validation Screen colonies by allele-specific PCR or Sanger sequencing to confirm biallelic APP^swe/swe knock-in. Validate absence of off-target edits (optional). Expand positive clones for further use. Notes Always confirm Cas9 induction and cutting efficiency in pilot experiments. Use low-passage WA09 cells to minimize risk of spontaneous karyotypic abnormalities. Notes T=0 and –DOX endpoint controls serve complementary roles; consistency between both strengthens confidence in hits. Before you Begin: Plate neurons into 96-well plates at 150,000 cells/cm². Maintain neurons in standard cortical neuron medium until DIV30. Begin Drug Treatment at DIV30 Prepare MLN4924 fresh from stock; avoid freeze–thaw cycles. Before you begin: Resuspend AggreSure Aβ42 (Anaspec) monomers in DMSO then dilute in PBS to generate a 100μM working solution. Store in single use aliquots at -80 until needed.
